get.summary: List/search command records across the shell and SQL audit streams.
get.description:
Filters (all optional, AND-combined): `session_id`, `user_id`,
`username`, `target_id`, `source` (`"shell"`|`"sql"`), `from`/`to`
(RFC3339 timestamps), and `q` (case-insensitive substring over the
command/query text). Results are newest-first; `limit` (default 100) and
`offset` (default 0) paginate.

200.description: The paused session was released with the given decision.

404.description: No pending review with this id (already decided, timed out, or unknown).

200.description: The paused session was released with the given decision.

404.description: No pending review with this id (already decided, timed out, or unknown).

get.summary:
List/search file operations, newest first. Filters are AND-combined;
`limit` defaults to 100.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Matches the username or the target snapshot.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only sessions started at or after this time.

delete.summary:
Close every live session. Admin-only — the whole `/admin/api` nest is
wrapped with `require_admin` (see `http_service::mod`), so a
non-admin caller is rejected with 403 before reaching this handler.

Delete all ended (historical) session records and their attached
recordings + log rows. Live sessions are left untouched.

200.description: Body is the number of session records deleted.

delete.summary:
Delete a session record and everything attached to it: its recording
files and rows, its log rows, and the session row. A still-live session
is closed first so no writer keeps a file open. Admin-only via the
`/admin/api` nest gate (`require_admin`).

post.summary:
Gracefully close a live session: signal its handle so the owning
protocol loop tears the session down and removes it from the registry
itself. Admin-only — the entire `/admin/api` nest is wrapped with
`require_admin` (see `http_service::mod`), so a non-admin caller is
rejected with 403 before reaching this handler.

Forcibly terminate a live session. Unlike graceful `close`, which only
signals the handle and waits for the protocol loop to self-remove, this
signals the handle **and** immediately evicts the session from the live
registry (marking it ended in the DB), so a wedged protocol loop cannot
keep the session alive. Admin-only via the `/admin/api` nest gate.

oneOf.description: Step-up confirmation; required for browser-session callers.

credentials_public.description:
Stored credentials with every sensitive value removed, so edit forms
can prefill usernames, engines, namespaces and CA certificates.

oneOf.description: Step-up confirmation; required for browser-session callers.

sha256_fingerprint.description: Uppercase colon-separated SHA-256 of the DER certificate.

subject_alt_names.description: DNS names and IP addresses from the subjectAltName extension.

CommandRecord.description:
One command record, unified across the shell-command and SQL audit streams.

`source` discriminates the origin (`"shell"` | `"sql"`). Shell records carry
the full command-ACL verdict (`acl_action`, `acl_rule_id`, `acl_rule_name`,
`outcome`); SQL records carry `success`/`error` instead and have those ACL
fields left null. Fields absent from a given source are `null` rather than
dropped so the shape round-trips both item kinds losslessly.

command.description: The shell command line or the SQL query text.

error.description: SQL only: error text when the statement failed.

success.description: SQL only: whether the statement executed successfully.

total.description: Total number of records matching the filters (before pagination).

CommandReviewItem.description: One pending command review, for the admin list/decision UI.

total.description: Total number of records matching the filters (before pagination).

HttpProxyRecordingItem.description:
API-visible projection of a recorded HTTP proxy exchange.  Bodies are
best-effort JSON-decoded for human inspection; non-JSON bodies surface
as `null`.

LifecycleRequest.description:
Password or OTP confirmation; may be omitted while the browser session's
step-up window is open.

version.description: Version to switch to; defaults to the available update.

current.description: Whether this is the caller's own browser session.

site_title.description:
Site title, at most 64 characters. Omitted leaves the current value
unchanged; an empty string restores the built-in "Gated".

sql_console_rate_limit_per_target.description:
Per-target request/minute limit for SQL Console and DB Terminal
gateway endpoints. `None` clears the limit.

sql_console_rate_limit_per_user.description:
Per-user request/minute limit for SQL Console and DB Terminal
gateway endpoints. `None` clears the limit.

terminal_watermark_enabled.description:
When true, the web terminal renders a frontend-only operator-identity +
timestamp watermark overlay. Omitted leaves the current value unchanged.

site_title.description:
Title shown on the login page, sidebar and browser tab. `None` uses
the built-in "Gated".

sql_console_rate_limit_per_target.description:
Per-target request/minute limit for SQL Console and DB Terminal
gateway endpoints. `None` means unlimited.

sql_console_rate_limit_per_user.description:
Per-user request/minute limit for SQL Console and DB Terminal
gateway endpoints. `None` means unlimited.

terminal_watermark_enabled.description:
When true, the web terminal renders a frontend-only operator-identity +
timestamp watermark overlay. Defaults to false.

reason.description: Optional free-text note recorded in the audit log.

allow_file_transfer.description: Defaults to `true` on create; unchanged on update when omitted.

builtin.description: True for the built-in admin role, which cannot be edited or deleted.

valid_until.description:
End of the browser session's open step-up window; null when a
confirmation is required.

TargetHttpOptions.description:
Unified HTTP-reverse-proxy target. `flavor` toggles Kubernetes-specific
behaviour (channel.k8s.io WebSocket, watch streaming, exec/attach
recording enrichment).

ca_certificate.description:
Optional PEM bundle of CA certificates trusted for the upstream
connection (e.g. an in-cluster signing CA).

flavor.description: Protocol-level behaviours unlocked for this target.

tls.description:
TLS settings for the upstream connection. `tls.verify` defaults to
`true`; set it to `false` only for a target with a self-signed or
otherwise unverifiable cert.

upstream_auth.description: How Gated authenticates to the upstream service.

url.description:
Upstream base URL (e.g. `https://kubernetes.example.com` for K8s,
or any http(s) origin for generic targets).

readonly.description:
When true, the SQL Console rejects anything not starting with
SELECT / SHOW / EXPLAIN / WITH. This is convenience-level only —
use a real read-only DB user for hard guarantees.

nonce.description: The check is done once `checked_nonce` reaches this value.

available.description: Newer version found by the last check.

check_error.description: Why the last update check failed.

checked_nonce.description: The highest update check lode has answered.

supervised.description: True when gated runs under lode; every other field is null otherwise.

error.description: Why the upstream could not be reached.

tls.description: False for an `http://` upstream; nothing else is reported then.

verify_error.description:
Why the chain fails verification against the system roots and the
target's CA bundle; null when it verifies.

roles.description: Names of the roles assigned to the user, sorted.
